### 更新 / Update
```sh
pip install -U openmd-cli
openmd browser-setup  # 仅 Windows：更新后重跑，同步扩展 / Windows only: rerun to sync extension
```
### 下载 / Download
| 系统 / OS | CLI（Python 3.10+） | 浏览器扩展 / Browser extension |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Windows | openmd_cli-VERSION-py3-none-any.whl | 支持 / Supported：[openmd-extension-VERSION.zip](https://github.com/baigao417/openmd/releases/download/vVERSION/openmd-extension-VERSION.zip)，解压后在 chrome://extensions 开发者模式加载 / unzip and Load unpacked |
| macOS | openmd_cli-VERSION-py3-none-any.whl | 暂不支持浏览器扩展，CLI 可用 / Extension unavailable; CLI supported |
| Linux | openmd_cli-VERSION-py3-none-any.whl | 暂不支持浏览器扩展，CLI 可用 / Extension unavailable; CLI supported |
